comment_regular: Verified shared texture dependency helper used by tree, landscape, and generated landscape-LOD paths. It queries the texture/resource cache; on a miss it creates and queues a QueuedTexture, while a hit with a parent creates an attached wrapper task so the dependency participates in parent completion. Caller priority and parent task are forwarded.
